description: Defines the class OX_ParserComponentGroup which extends OX_ParserBase to parse XML plugin installation files for the Revive Adserver project, handling various plugin components, schemas, navigation, and configuration data.

classes.name: OX_ParserComponentGroup
classes.description: A parser class for processing XML plugin installation files, managing plugin components, schemas, navigation, and configuration data.

methods.name: startHandler
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, initializing data structures based on element type.

methods.name: endHandler
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, aggregating parsed data into class properties.

methods.name: cdataHandler
methods.description: Processes character data within XML elements, updating schema, file, and component information.
